findings.claim: The invoked-via-prompt-start check uses a bare glob prefix match (case "$first_user" in "/$required"*), so a required skill name that is a prefix of another skill (e.g. REQUIRE-SKILL:smine matched by /smine-batch) incorrectly passes the gate as invoked.
findings.fix: Require a word boundary after the name, e.g. case "$first_user" in "/$required" | "/$required "*) invoked=1 ;; esac, and add a regression case to cmd/tests/test_skill_invoke_gate.sh for a required name that is a prefix of another skill's name.

findings.claim: handleReposAdd grants permissions.additionalDirectories but handleReposDelete never revokes it, leaving a deleted repo's directory grantable/readable indefinitely, with the gap tracked only in a plan's Deferred findings bullet.
findings.fix: Track the revoke-on-delete gap as a durable open item (an issue or TODO with an owner) that outlives the plan directory once it is archived.

findings.claim: The smine-orchestrate skill, which merges and pushes to origin/main unattended while judging content it doesn't fully control, is granted unrestricted Bash(git *) in its frontmatter — a wider blast radius than its documented duties need.
findings.fix: Narrow the allowlist to the specific git subcommands actually used (merge --no-edit, push origin main, status, merge-base --is-ancestor, log, remote get-url), consistent with the file's other deliberately narrowed allowlists.

findings.claim: The new build-install target's doc-comment is copy-pasted verbatim from build (## build: build all binaries and install), so make help prints two entries both labeled build, one describing the wrong target.
findings.fix: Rename the doc-comment to the target's own name (## build-install: ...).

findings.claim: styleTestTarget joins an admin-configured ROUTINE_TOKEN env value directly into filepath.Join(s.tokenDir, label) with no validation that label stays within tokenDir before reading it and feeding its contents to claude -p as an OAuth token.
findings.fix: Add a filepath.Clean plus prefix check if that env ever becomes reachable from a less-trusted input path.

findings.claim: .gitignore still ends without a trailing newline (pre-existing, but the diff touches the same lines and could have fixed it in passing).
